description: This file contains functions and data structures definitions for packing and creating a data model in XML format for a broadband device management system, specifically for a Cisco MTA Agent component. It heavily utilizes functions for creating XML nodes, objects, and parameters, representing a detailed data model schema.

methods.name: PVOID DMPackCreateDataModelXML()
methods.description: Creates and returns an XML data model representing device configuration parameters, including various objects such as 'X_CISCO_COM_MTA_V6', 'X_CISCO_COM_MTA', 'Dect', 'Battery', and others, with their associated parameters and nested objects.
